instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt cap is reached, and
reaching the cap is charged the full cap. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

H,W=test.shape
out=np.ones_like(test)
axis_c=8
# Preserve 7 pixels on the axis and extend the edge marker to the farthest axial 7.
axis_rows=np.where(test[:,axis_c]==7)[0]
for r in axis_rows: out[r,axis_c]=7
# marker is at top, so color the axis from top through the last axial 7
last=int(axis_rows.max())
out[:last+1,axis_c][test[:last+1,axis_c]!=7]=2
# Move off-axis pixels to top-left / top-right, preserving each side's pattern.
for side, dest in [('left','left'),('right','right')]:
    coords=np.argwhere((test==7) & ((np.indices(test.shape)[1]<axis_c) if side=='left' else (np.indices(test.shape)[1]>axis_c)))
    if not len(coords): continue
    rmin,cmin=coords.min(axis=0); rmax,cmax=coords.max(axis=0)
    # align the bounding box against the top and corresponding side edge
    dr=-int(rmin)
    if dest=='left': dc=-int(cmin)
    else: dc=(W-1-int(cmax))-0
    for r,c in coords:
        out[int(r)+dr,int(c)+dc]=7
print('7 count',np.sum(out==7),'2 count',np.sum(out==2))
render(out)
print('rows JSON:', out.tolist())
